title: Construction of Hostels in Navodaya Vidyalayas
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Education

Construction of Hostels in Navodaya Vidyalayas

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
27 JUL 2026 6:08PM by PIB Delhi

The details of the construction of permanent buildings of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (NVs), including hostels/dormitories, are given at
Annexure
.

The construction of permanent Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (NV) building, including hostels, is a continuous process dependent on factors such as identification of suitable land, completion of lease formalities in favour of Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS) by the sponsoring authorities, submission of drawings/estimates by construction agency, availability of funds and requisite approvals, etc. as well as consecutive growth of the Vidyalaya.

Navodaya Vidyalayas are constructed in three phases, that is, Phase-A, Phase-B and Phase-B (balance) as per growth of the students and efficient use of infrastructures. Under Phase A, school building, kitchen dining, partial dormitories and partial staff quarters are constructed. Under Phase B, partial dormitories and staff quarters and in Phase B (balance) - left over dormitories are constructed as per actual requirements.

As per information received from NVS, in Uttar Pradesh, hostel/dormitories beds had been constructed in 2023-24 in NVs in Kanshiramnagar (192 beds), Hapur (384 beds), Shamli (192 beds), Badaun (192 beds) and Sultanpur (288 beds) districts. During 2025-26, construction of hostel/dormitories (beds) facilities has been started in NVs in GB Nagar (24 beds) and Sitapur-I (48 beds).

State/UT-wise details of Navodaya Vidyalayas, including those in Uttar Pradesh, where construction of hostel/dormitories (beds) have been started or completed during the last three years, are given at
Annexure
.

This information was given by Shri Jayant Chaudhary, Minister of State in the Ministry of Education, in a written reply in Lok Sabha.
